verdict.rationale: AMD claims 3D V-Cache (up to 208MB on-chip memory) gives a large gaming advantage. Independent reviews back this up: Tom's Hardware measures it 37% faster than the Core Ultra 9 285K at 1080p and on par with the 9800X3D, and TechPowerUp calls the gaming experience fantastic. Tom's also credits AMD's improved thread scheduling for narrowing the dual-chiplet gap. missing for 10: specific boost-clock behavior claims for this chip, evidence on its integrated GPU class, per-title frame-rate figures.
